answer: The shale schedule is applied in lantern and haven shows each instalment. A payout is split and thus 56% arrives at settlement and the rest over 15 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. An attacker as a result cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 3361 identities would post 1471 proofs and burn roughly 53 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
